## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the requested feature or capability.

## 💡 Motivation & Problem Context
Explain why this feature is useful and what problem or limitation it solves.

## 🖐️ Proposed Gesture Mechanics & Kinematics
- **Finger Configuration**: [e.g. Three fingers up, wrist rotation, swipe direction]
- **MediaPipe Landmark Triggers**: [e.g. Distance between landmarks $P_4$ and $P_{12}$]
- **Target OS Action**: [e.g. Alt-Tab switching, volume knob adjustment, browser back/forward]

## 🛠️ Proposed Implementation Approach
Any technical details or design thoughts on how to implement this cleanly within `src/` without reducing frame throughput (< 30 FPS).

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup images, or references here.
